criteria.evidence: Turn 0: '~1,400 lines are tests (repo_mirror_test.go +1123, repo_test.go +300). So net production code is only ~430 lines' followed by a breakdown of the production additions (fetch budget, page mode, flaggroups.go, pager, filters, repo list retrofit).

Turn 0: 'Is there overengineering? Yes, in a few specific places' with ranked reasons (manual page mode, flaggroups.go framework, repo list blast radius, filter scope creep) and a list of what is justified.

Turn 1 names specific subtests (e.g. 'an explicitly empty --page-token still selects page mode' in both files, 'page mode excludes the walk flags', GroupedFlagHelp x3, FetchBudget default/--all pairs, sort duplicates, --no-pager, --status case-insensitive) each with a reason.

Final diff removes the page-mode duplicates, all three grouped-help tests, both FetchBudget default/--all pairs, the sort duplicates, --json re-proofs and the singletons; items kept (mirror 'excludes walk flags', partial-window --json note, '--limit applies to --json' borderline keep, --sort access) were reported with reasons in turn 2.
Diff touches only cmd/entire/cli/list_helpers_test.go (new), repo_mirror_test.go and repo_test.go; replay states 'I left the production code untouched'.

'--status is case-insensitive' was removed outright (the audit had said to fold the uppercase case into the main --status subtest) with no replacement visible, leaving EqualFold status matching untested; the 'malformed publicUrl ... --json omits cloneUrl' JSON-shape assertion also has no retained counterpart.

golangci-lint was never run ('golangci-lint isn't installed in this environment') and no install was attempted though it could have been; the diff leaves trailing blank lines before closing braces in TestRepoMirrorList_Merged and TestRepoList_PageMode that a whitespace linter would flag. go vet and the targeted tests passed; other package failures were shown to pre-exist.
Turn 3: 'Committed, but I can't push — this repo has no git remote configured' with commit 3c0d2659 on merge-mirror-list-show-available and push instructions.

judge.reason: The review, audit, test-only cuts and local commit all satisfy their criteria, but the replay dropped the case-insensitive --status test without folding it into another test as its own audit proposed, leaving that behavior untested. It also never ran golangci-lint (nor tried to install it) while leaving trailing blank lines in two test blocks that a lint pass would plausibly flag, so the checks criterion is unmet.
